Research notes (for the Toronto Raptors, as of Monday, Oct 12, 2026):

- The Raptors do not appear to play tonight, Oct 12. Their NBA.com schedule lists no game on that date. It goes from a preseason game on Oct 10 straight to one on Oct 13.
- Their next game is tomorrow, Tuesday, Oct 13. It's a preseason game against the New York Knicks at Scotiabank Arena in Toronto, tipping at 7:00 pm ET. NBA.com, ESPN, Sync2Cal and Yahoo Sports all agree on this. One Raptors Republic preview also gives 7 PM for Oct 13.
- Tonight the Knicks are reportedly hosting the Minnesota Timberwolves, per a Fubo listing. That is not a Raptors game.
- The Raptors' most recent game was Saturday, Oct 10, a preseason game against the Clippers in Vancouver. ESPN and NBA.com show a Raptors win, 114–106.
- After that, the Raptors play the Knicks again on Thu, Oct 15 at Madison Square Garden (7:30 pm ET). They then play the Pistons on Fri, Oct 16 in Detroit (7:00 pm ET). Their regular season opens Wed, Oct 21 at home against Chicago (7:30 pm ET).
- Sync2Cal lists Oct 13 as shown in New York time (UTC-4), which is Eastern. The question gave no time zone or location, so game times are given in ET only.
- One Sports Media Watch snippet, about 7 days old, lists a Raptors vs. Detroit game and a Raptors vs. Minnesota regular-season game. It gives no dates, and it conflicts with the other sources, which show those games as away games. I'm not treating it as reliable.
